search: Listed all files under agent/ and grepped for checkpoint, replay, recover, resume, idempot, hash, hmac, sign, retry, resend, sequence, reconcil, restart, crash, attempt, backoff, tenacity, and audit_events. Read audit.py, loop.py, main.py lifespan/sweeper, payments.py and migrations/001_init.sql. audit_events is only written (INSERT) by audit.record and is never read back by any application code. Each run starts fresh from the task, with no resume or checkpoint load. The only background job is the approvals expiry sweeper, which reads the approvals table and not logs. No retry or replay loop exists. pay_invoice makes a single POST with an Idempotency-Key, and a failure is recorded as tool_error and returned to the model.
note: No logs or checkpoints drive recovery and there is no automatic replay, so the N/A condition is met and R14 does not apply.
